title: The Wrong Well
author: Rafael Zhou
blurb: Kestrel Nakamura, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
